questions.text: In a class of 40 students, 25 play football, 20 play basketball and 8 play both games. How many play neither game?
questions.explanation: Only football = 25 − 8 = 17; only basketball = 20 − 8 = 12. Playing at least one game = 17 + 12 + 8 = 37, so neither = 40 − 37 = 3.

questions.text: If n(A) = 12, n(B) = 9 and n(A ∪ B) = 16, find n(A ∩ B).
questions.explanation: n(A ∪ B) = n(A) + n(B) − n(A ∩ B), so 16 = 12 + 9 − n(A ∩ B), giving n(A ∩ B) = 5.

questions.text: Factorize x² − 5x + 6.
questions.explanation: Two numbers with product 6 and sum −5 are −2 and −3, so x² − 5x + 6 = (x − 2)(x − 3).

questions.text: If x + 2 is a factor of x² + kx + 6, find k.
questions.explanation: By the factor theorem, f(−2) = 0: 4 − 2k + 6 = 0, so 2k = 10 and k = 5.

questions.text: Solve the simultaneous equations x + y = 7 and x − y = 3.
questions.explanation: Adding: 2x = 10, so x = 5. Substituting: 5 + y = 7, so y = 2.

questions.text: Make r the subject of the formula V = πr²h.
questions.explanation: Divide by πh: r² = V/πh, then take the square root: r = √(V/πh).

questions.text: If y varies directly as x and y = 12 when x = 4, find y when x = 9.
questions.explanation: y = kx gives 12 = 4k, so k = 3 and y = 3x. When x = 9, y = 27.

questions.text: If p varies inversely as q and p = 6 when q = 4, find p when q = 8.
Solve 3x − 5 > 7.
Find the range of values of x for which x² − 3x + 2 < 0.
questions.explanation: x² − 3x + 2 = (x − 1)(x − 2). The product is negative when x lies between the roots: 1 < x < 2.

questions.text: Find the 10th term of the arithmetic progression 3, 7, 11, ...
questions.explanation: a = 3, d = 4. The nth term is a + (n−1)d, so the 10th term is 3 + 9×4 = 39.

questions.text: Find the sum of the first 8 terms of the geometric progression 2, 6, 18, ...

The sum of the interior angles of a polygon is 1260°. How many sides does it have?
In a circle, the angle at the centre subtended by a chord is 80°. Find the angle at the circumference subtended by the same chord.
questions.explanation: The angle at the centre is twice the angle at the circumference, so the angle is 80°/2 = 40°.

questions.text: Each exterior angle of a regular polygon is 30°. How many sides does the polygon have?
questions.explanation: The exterior angles sum to 360°, so the number of sides is 360/30 = 12.

questions.text: Find the volume of a cylinder of radius 7 cm and height 10 cm. (Take π = 22/7)
Find the length of an arc of a circle of radius 21 cm subtended by an angle of 60° at the centre. (Take π = 22/7)
Find the total surface area of a cuboid 6 cm by 4 cm by 3 cm.
The locus of points equidistant from two fixed points A and B is the ___.
questions.explanation: Points equidistant from A and B lie on the perpendicular bisector of the line joining them.

questions.text: The locus of a point which moves so that its distance from a fixed point is always 5 cm is a ___.
questions.explanation: All points at a fixed distance from a fixed point form a circle with that radius.

questions.text: Find the gradient of the line joining the points (2, 3) and (6, 11).

questions.explanation: Using y = mx + c with m = 3 and c = 2 gives y = 3x + 2.

questions.text: If sin θ = 3/5 and θ is acute, find cos θ.
questions.explanation: For a 3-4-5 right-angled triangle, the adjacent side is 4, so cos θ = 4/5.

questions.text: Evaluate tan 45° + sin 30°.
questions.explanation: tan 45° = 1 and sin 30° = 1/2, so the sum is 1 + 1/2 = 3/2.

questions.text: A ladder 10 m long leans against a wall, making an angle of 60° with the ground. How high up the wall does it reach?
Find the area of a triangle with sides 5 cm and 8 cm and included angle 30°.
questions.explanation: Area = ½ab sin C = ½ × 5 × 8 × sin 30° = 20 × 1/2 = 10 cm².

questions.text: Find dy/dx if y = 3x³ − 2x² + 5.
questions.explanation: Differentiating term by term: d/dx(3x³) = 9x², d/dx(−2x²) = −4x, and the constant 5 differentiates to 0.

questions.text: Differentiate y = sin 2x with respect to x.
questions.explanation: By the chain rule, d/dx(sin 2x) = 2 cos 2x.

questions.text: Find the maximum value of y = −x² + 6x − 5.
questions.explanation: dy/dx = −2x + 6 = 0 gives x = 3. At x = 3, y = −9 + 18 − 5 = 4, and the second derivative is negative, so this is a maximum.

questions.text: A curve is given by y = x³ − 3x. Find the x-coordinates of its turning points.
questions.explanation: dy/dx = 3x² − 3. Setting this to zero gives x² = 1, so x = 1 or x = −1.

questions.text: Evaluate ∫(2x + 3) dx.
questions.explanation: ∫2x dx = x² and ∫3 dx = 3x, so the integral is x² + 3x + C.

questions.text: Evaluate ∫₀¹ (3x² + 2) dx.
In a pie chart, the sector representing 45 pupils out of 180 has an angle of ___.
The table shows books read by 40 students: 0–4 books: 8 students; 5–9 books: 14 students; 10–14 books: 12 students; 15–19 books: 6 students. How many students read fewer than 10 books?
questions.explanation: Fewer than 10 books means the first two classes: 8 + 14 = 22 students.

questions.text: Find the mean of 4, 8, 9, 11 and 13.
Find the median of 7, 3, 9, 5, 11 and 4.
questions.explanation: In order: 3, 4, 5, 7, 9, 11. The median is the average of the two middle values: (5 + 7)/2 = 6.

questions.text: Find the range of 12, 7, 19, 5, 23 and 9.
Find the standard deviation of 2, 4, 6 and 8.
questions.explanation: Mean = 5. Squared deviations: 9, 1, 1, 9, totalling 20. Variance = 20/4 = 5, so standard deviation = √5.

questions.text: In how many ways can 4 books be arranged on a shelf from a collection of 6 different books?
A committee of 3 is to be chosen from 7 people. In how many ways can this be done?
A fair die is thrown once. Find the probability of obtaining a prime number.
questions.explanation: The prime numbers on a die are 2, 3 and 5: 3 out of 6 outcomes, giving 3/6 = 1/2.

questions.text: Two fair coins are tossed. Find the probability of obtaining two heads.
questions.explanation: There are 4 equally likely outcomes (HH, HT, TH, TT) and only one is two heads: 1/4.

questions.text: A bag contains 5 red balls and 3 blue balls. One ball is drawn at random. Find the probability that it is red.
questions.explanation: There are 5 red balls out of 8 balls in total, so the probability is 5/8.
